_: The shorts by number for docs/reels/ (the profile link on Instagram and TikTok): a caption says «#6 · link in bio», the page leads on to the puzzle or glossary article. Numbers never change; a new short takes the next one. date = first publication anywhere (YouTube); until that day the page hides the row. page = a problem slug, glossary/<article> or blog/<post>. hook = the short's own question or first line, never the answer.
